params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). In the lower half of the frame: a long dark matte desk with seven laptops standing in a row and receding into darkness; only the first laptop in front is open and its screen glows warm yellow (#FDD506) showing an abstract website layout with placeholder blocks and no readable text; the other six laptops are closed and dark with a faint warm rim light on their edges. Shallow depth of field, thin haze, subtle golden dust. The upper 55% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm, one-of-seven mood.
